query:
UPDATE heartbeat_checks SET
                paused_at        = ?,
                paused_until     = ?,
                pause_origin     = 'service',
                pause_reason     = ?,
                pause_until_ping = ?,
                updated_at       = unixepoch()
              WHERE id = ?
                AND NOT (paused_at IS NOT NULL
                         AND pause_origin = 'operator'
                         AND (paused_until IS NULL OR paused_until > ?))
